verdict.rationale: Brex is a spend-management platform that ships automations: AI-powered invoice entry and approval, automated GL coding, auto-enforced budget controls, and Pipedream/Zapier integrations. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back those automations is therefore a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions version history, change review, or rollback for automations or workflows, so absence of evidence yields none.
